description.tr: İlk insan uçuş denemesi — kanatlar inşa edip Kurtuba yakınlarında bir tepeden yaklaşık 10 dakika süzüldü. Ayrıca yapay gök gürültüsü ve şimşekli bir planetaryum yarattı || İbn Firnâs, ilk belgelenmiş insan uçuşu denemesini yapan Emevi Kurtuba'sında Berberî bir polimâttı. || [Tarih notu] el-Makkarî'nin Nefhu't-Tîb'i (17. yy.) birincil kaynaktır.
description.en: First human flight attempt — built wings and glided from a hill near Córdoba for approximately 10 minutes, landing with injuries. Also created a planetarium with artificial thunder and lightning, and manufactured clear glass (rock crystal) || Ibn Firnas was a Berber polymath in Umayyad Córdoba who made the first documented attempt at human flight. He also built a water clock, manufactured clear glass from quartz, and created a room-sized planetarium. The source mentions him in the Andalusia lecture on science as a key figure of early Andalusian innovation. || [Historiographical note] Al-Maqqari's Nafh al-Tib (17th c.) is the primary source. The Baghdad airport Ibn Firnas statue and the lunar crater named after him attest to his enduring fame. Some scholars question whether the flight lasted 10 minutes or was briefer.
description.ar: أول محاولة طيران بشرية — صنع جناحين وحلّق من تلة قرب قرطبة نحو ١٠ دقائق. كما صنع قبة فلكية بالرعد والبرق || كان ابن فرناس عالمًا أمازيغيًا في قرطبة الأموية قام بأول محاولة موثقة للطيران البشري. صنع أيضًا ساعة مائية وزجاجًا شفافًا من الكوارتز
